skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Burst Feline
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Burst Feline. Stage clothing picked by drummer Blaze herself. There might not be much material, but it's breathable, sweat-absorbent and flame-resistant, ensuring no outfit malfunctions will affect Blaze's performance.
skins.quote: Percussion's suited to those spirits born to be wild, just because when they hit it, you know it'll be with all their strength.

skins.name: Explosive Blue Flame
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Explosive Blue Flame. She plays the role of the hero seeking the grimoire said to have been born amidst the Everlasting Flame. Whichever brave soul claims it can break through all rules and bindings.
skins.quote: Some have noticed a set of suspicious inky footprints on Rhodes Island. They go from the rest area to the control center, leading the curious to see Blaze dragging Amiya along on her pawprint seal playtime.
